finding.headline: Transfers remain healthy on ethereum → base via across, but destination settlement is under pressure on USDT.

finding.corroborationText: Transfers are healthy over the last hour, while destination settlement is under pressure on USDT. The two are independent measurements, and they disagree.

observed.text: Transfer health is healthy over the last hour. One-hour transfer times are p50 120s and p90 300s. Over 24 hours, 99.5% of 90 observable transfers succeeded.

context.text: Context only: base flow status is outflow, -$210,000 net over 24h. Chain flow is bridge-agnostic and does not affect this route tier.
